question: Aconcagua Oil & Extract S.A. parent company
markdown:
Aconcagua Oil & Extract S.A.
is a privately held, independent specialty food producer based in San Felipe, Valparaíso, Chile, known for creating extra virgin and cold-pressed avocado oil brands like
Paltita
. It operates as an independent boutique entity with no publicly designated larger corporate parent company or multi-national conglomerate owner.
(Note: It is frequently confused with
Aconcagua Foods S.A.
, a large, separate Chilean canned fruit and vegetable multinational that is owned by the Mexican parent company
La Costeña
